Highlights
Marvel at the natural wonders of the sky in San Pedro de Atacama
Discover the fascinating mysteries of the universe with an astronomer
Travel back to Ancient Greece and learn how they looked at the night sky
Let go of your worries as you relax under thousands of shining stars
Full description
Immerse yourself in the magic of the nocturnal sky with a guided stargazing or moon and planets excursion in San Pedro de Atacama. Acquire new knowledge about astronomy in an immersive experience with a professional.

We meet at a specific point in town and drive 15 minutes away from the town center. Arrive at the observation site and receive a brief explanation, then begin your fascinating observation of the night sky with the naked eye.

Next, learn how to observe through telescopes and find objects such as planets, stars, binary stars, stellar clusters, nebulas, and galaxies, depending on the time of the year. Take some photos with the stars as a memory of the night and finish with a snack and hot drinks before the drive back.

Meeting point
The meeting point is at the school E26, just a few meters away from the pedestrian street Caracoles and the Apacheta square. We do drop-off to the different hotels close to the town center. We don't drive outside from town to ayllus such as Solor, Beter, Cucuter, Tulor, Coyo, Yaye, Checar, Sequitor and Quitor.

September 14, 2026 - Verified booking
Really good experience, instructions for pick-up were clear, driver was good, he even waited 15 mins for 2 guests who were lost, went back to pick them up later. The stargazing was lovely, the guide was really knowledgeable and explained things clearly. I would suggest to show the constellations on an iPad or something to help guests being able to see them more clearly on the sky. They also took two photos of guests and sent them via email a few days later along with some lovely photos of different objects on the sky. We looked terrible on our photos though, it's a shame they don't let you retake them. They also had some drinks which was a nice touch. Overall very well organised and great experience, we learned a lot. Totally recommended!
